headline: Youth arrested for journalist Alif's murder in Netrokona
summary: The 22-year-old suspect, Opurba, allegedly carried weapons for the prime suspect, a known contract killer.
details: Police have arrested 22-year-old Opurba from Durgapur municipal town in Netrokona on suspicion of involvement in the shooting death of journalist Lutfuzzaman Fakir, alias Alif Fakir.
According to Durgapur Police Station OC Khandaker Shaker Ahmed, Opurba was present at the crime scene and was allegedly carrying the bag containing the weapons used in the killing.
Police claim that Opurba is the nephew of the prime suspect, who is described as a contract killer for hire.
Investigations reveal that Opurba allegedly helped the prime suspect evade arrest by hiding during the day and only coming out after midnight.
Opurba was also an accused in a previous case where journalist Alif Fakir was critically injured by sharp weapons in November last year.
Journalist Alif was shot dead on October 15 around 8:15 pm while returning home after having tea at a stall in the Telanjia area of Durgapur upazila.
The victim's wife has filed a murder case with Durgapur Police Station accusing seven to eight unidentified individuals.
caption:
A youth has been arrested for his role in the murder of journalist Alif Fakir. He allegedly carried the weapons for a contract killer.

Police have arrested 22-year-old Opurba from Durgapur municipal town in Netrokona on suspicion of involvement in the shooting death of journalist Lutfuzzaman Fakir, alias Alif Fakir.

According to Durgapur Police Station OC Khandaker Shaker Ahmed, Opurba was present at the crime scene and was allegedly carrying the bag containing the weapons used in the killing.

Police claim that Opurba is the nephew of the prime suspect, who is described as a contract killer for hire.

Investigations reveal that Opurba allegedly helped the prime suspect evade arrest by hiding during the day and only coming out after midnight.

Opurba was also an accused in a previous case where journalist Alif Fakir was critically injured by sharp weapons in November last year.

Journalist Alif was shot dead on October 15 around 8:15 pm while returning home after having tea at a stall in the Telanjia area of Durgapur upazila.

The victim's wife has filed a murder case with Durgapur Police Station accusing seven to eight unidentified individuals.

headline_marked: Satkhira: [[Prime accused in mob killing arrested]]
headline: Satkhira: Prime accused in mob killing arrested
summary: Fazlul Haque Amini, a local leader of 'Tawhidi Janata', was apprehended by police and SRB during a drive in Kaliganj.
details: Fazlul Haque Amini, the prime accused in the murder case of Wahiduzzaman Shamim, has been arrested. He was apprehended by police and the SRB during a joint drive in the Krishnanagar area of Kaliganj upazila.

Wahiduzzaman Shamim was beaten to death by a mob in two separate attacks on October 13. The first assault occurred in the Kulia area, and the second took place inside the Debhata Upazila Health Complex.
The violence was triggered by a leaked audio recording of a family dispute between Shamim and his wife. This led to allegations that he had made derogatory remarks that hurt religious sentiments.
According to the victim's brother, Amini had gone live on Facebook to allege blasphemy and call people to gather before the attacks occurred.
Shamim was rescued by police from the first attack and taken to the health complex, but an agitated crowd attacked him again in the presence of police officers.
He was later transferred to Satkhira Medical College Hospital, where he was declared dead on arrival. A case has since been filed naming 10 people and 200 to 250 unidentified suspects.
Two other accused, Mukter Hossain Khan and Asadul Islam Molla, have already been arrested and sent to jail.
caption:
A man was beaten to death in two separate attacks, including one inside a health complex. The prime accused has now been arrested.

Fazlul Haque Amini, the prime accused in the murder case of Wahiduzzaman Shamim, has been arrested. He was apprehended by police and the SRB during a joint drive in the Krishnanagar area of Kaliganj upazila.

Wahiduzzaman Shamim was beaten to death by a mob in two separate attacks on October 13. The first assault occurred in the Kulia area, and the second took place inside the Debhata Upazila Health Complex.

The violence was triggered by a leaked audio recording of a family dispute between Shamim and his wife. This led to allegations that he had made derogatory remarks that hurt religious sentiments.

According to the victim's brother, Amini had gone live on Facebook to allege blasphemy and call people to gather before the attacks occurred.

Shamim was rescued by police from the first attack and taken to the health complex, but an agitated crowd attacked him again in the presence of police officers.

He was later transferred to Satkhira Medical College Hospital, where he was declared dead on arrival. A case has since been filed naming 10 people and 200 to 250 unidentified suspects.

Two other accused, Mukter Hossain Khan and Asadul Islam Molla, have already been arrested and sent to jail.
